cpBeforeFunction:
cd ~/work/lane && F=scripts/install-smoke/apt-mirrors.sh; cp $F /tmp/lane/good.sh
mut() { cp /tmp/lane/good.sh $F; sed -i "$1" $F; echo "== mutant: $2"; diff /tmp/lane/good.sh $F; bash -c "bun test scripts/install-smoke/run-sh.test.ts -t apt-mirrors > /tmp/lane/m.log 2>&1; echo exit=\$? >> /tmp/lane/m.log"; grep -E "^\(fail\)|^exit=|^error:|run-sh.test.ts:[0-9]+" /tmp/lane/m.log | head -12; }
mut 's/^  apt-get update --error-on=any \&\& return 0$/  apt-get update \&\& return 0/' "first apt-get update without --error-on=any"
mut '/^  write_lists "\$other"$/d' "retry keeps the same mirror first"
mut 's/^  sleep "\$retry_pause"$/  :/' "no pause before the retry"
cp /tmp/lane/good.sh $F; cmp /tmp/lane/good.sh $F && echo restored; git status --porcelain
